aa_remetz.name: Remetz Laser Carrier
aa_remetz.blurb: A laser that burns small drones out of the air, and goes dark behind smoke or a wall.

air_medevac_heli.name: Nachlieli Medevac
air_medevac_heli.blurb: Flies four wounded out of the fight. Unarmed, and it lands to load.

apc_eitan.name: Eitan APC
apc_eitan.blurb: Armour that keeps up with the tanks, seats for two, and a gun that answers aircraft.

apc_kipod.name: Kipod Screen Carrier
apc_kipod.blurb: Six seats behind reactive plate, and a gun that pins people without killing a truck.

at_nlos_team.name: Zaron Missile Team
at_nlos_team.blurb: Kills what your side has spotted, without a sight line and at low collateral. Useless up close.

at_team.name: Spike AT Team
at_team.blurb: Kills armour that rifles cannot touch, one missile at a time. Place it before you need it.

attack_drone.name: Loitering Munition
attack_drone.blurb: Flies itself at the nearest thing your side has identified, and does not come back.

breach_team.name: Tzinah Breach Team
breach_team.blurb: Empties a garrisoned house instead of levelling it. No sustained fire costs Conduct less.

demo_squad.name: Combat Engineers
demo_squad.blurb: Brings a building down from touching distance, without shelling the street to do it.

demo_tzav.name: Shiryonan Demolition Carrier
demo_tzav.blurb: Sets a fused charge against a wall and backs off. What stands too close goes with the house.

dozer_d9.name: D9 Dov
dozer_d9.blurb: Takes a building down with a blade instead of a shell. Unarmed, and it cannot be hurried.

heli_peten.name: AH-64 Peten
heli_peten.blurb: Crosses the map in seconds and kills armour at standoff. The cannon is the expensive half.

heli_peten_gunship.name: Peten Gunship
heli_peten_gunship.blurb: A Peten with the hull for one more pass: the cannon for the open ground, Hellfires for armour.

heli_yanshuf.name: UH-60 Yanshuf
heli_yanshuf.blurb: Six squads anywhere on the map in a minute. Lose it in the air and you lose all of them.

ifv_namer.name: Namer IFV
ifv_namer.blurb: Carries five under armour, but its 30mm is what arms the protected-zone penalty.

inf_grenadier.name: Chomet Grenadier Squad
inf_grenadier.blurb: Grenades reach men behind a wall, never inside a house. In a flagged street they cost Conduct.

inf_medic_squad.name: Nemala Medic Team
inf_medic_squad.blurb: Treats wounded men under fire and stretchers them out. It barely fights, and a load slows it.

inf_squad.name: Rifle Squad
inf_squad.blurb: Holds ground and garrisons buildings. Its rifles are the safest thing to fire in a street.

jeep_shoded.name: Shoded Jeep
jeep_shoded.blurb: Fast and thin. Two seats, a machine gun, and nothing at all that stops a rocket.

mbt_lavi.name: Lavi MBT
mbt_lavi.blurb: Wins any duel it can see out to twelve tiles. Its 120mm is the costliest round for ROE.

mbt_lavi_camo.name: Lavi Ambush Tank
mbt_lavi_camo.blurb: Waits under a net and is seen late. The net fouls its active protection, and a shot shows it.

mortar_team.name: 60mm Mortar Team
mortar_team.blurb: Fires past its own sight, so someone else must look. You are billed for where it lands.

recon_drone.name: Recon Drone
recon_drone.blurb: Sees sixteen tiles, further than anything else, and marks what it finds. Carries no weapon.

recon_zikit.name: Shmamit Deep Recon Team
recon_zikit.blurb: Keeps a tunnel in sight from boulders or a house, unseen. Once found, it loses the fight.

scout_shachaf.name: Shachaf Scout Car
scout_shachaf.blurb: A ground eye that sees sixteen tiles and cannot be shot down. Carries a mast, not a gun.

sniper_team.name: Sniper Team
sniper_team.blurb: Takes one man at a time, at the least cost a shot can carry. Firing shows the hide.

spg_cluster.name: Te'o Cluster Howitzer
spg_cluster.blurb: Bomblets shred men and trucks in the open, not armour or houses. Conduct pays for every round.

spg_long_range.name: Te'o Howitzer
spg_long_range.blurb: Reaches deeper than any other gun and sees none of it. Every round is billed where it lands.

ugv_recon_dog.name: Chadaf Recon Robot
ugv_recon_dog.blurb: Walks boulders and alleys no wheel can, and finds tunnel routes. Unarmed, and cheap to lose.

veh_ambulance.name: Pered Armoured Ambulance
veh_ambulance.blurb: Carries four wounded under armour, and none bleeds near it. No gun at all.

wounded_kdf.name: Wounded Soldier
wounded_kdf.blurb: A man down. He bleeds out unless a medic reaches him, and nobody fires on him.

wounded_sarim.name: Wounded Fighter
wounded_sarim.blurb: A man down. He bleeds out unless a medic reaches him, and nobody fires on him.

yahalom_squad.name: Yahalom Engineers
yahalom_squad.blurb: The only team that can collapse a tunnel.
